'''Jetok''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was active as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and was hired by [[House of Thul|House Thul]] to make deliveries to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. However, he was cut down by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces along with many Thul [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] while making a delivery to [[King's Pass]].
